name: sqf-private-variable-checker
description: Checks all local variables and informs the user if there are non-private local vars.

commands.title: Check Workspace for Non-Private Local Variables
Check Current File for Non-Private Local Variables

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.enable.description: Enable checking of .sqf files for local variables that are assigned without being declared private.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.include.description: Glob pattern for the files included in a workspace scan.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from a workspace scan.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.severity.description: Severity reported in the Problems panel.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.checkOnType.description: Re-check an .sqf file while typing. When false, files are only checked on open and on save.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.treatParamsAsP.description: Treat variables declared via params ["_x"] as private.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.treatForLoopVa.description: Treat the counter in for "_i" from 0 to 10 as private.

sqfPrivateVariableChecker.magicVariables.description: Additional engine- or macro-supplied variables that must never be reported, for example _fnc_myMacroVar. Names are case insensitive and added to the built-in list (_this, _x, _forEachIndex, _exception, ...).

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
